## Professional Skills

**Working with people.** It's the reason I want to be in the field. As a camp counselor, I was responsible for eight 12-year-olds on multi-day wilderness trips. That meant keeping a group engaged, safe, and moving in the same direction.

**Attention to detail.** At Standish, I reviewed and marked up unaudited quarterly financial statements before senior review, and reconciled LP allocation data where every dollar has to tie out.

**Safety and procedures.** As a lifeguard and a counselor, my job was to follow safety protocols every time, with no shortcuts. That's the same mindset a jobsite demands.

**Teamwork.** I worked through every stage of our team's eight-part pro forma, from the rent roll to the final walk-away price.

**Adaptability.** I spent a semester at the Prague University of Economics and Business, including intensive Czech. I learned quickly how to operate somewhere unfamiliar.

**Time management.** I balance the 4+1 program, professional work, and committee roles in Beta Theta Pi and Special Olympics Colorado.
